commit.message:
llama: fix stack overflow in the expert-pool tensor collector

MoE architectures with separate ffn_up_exps / ffn_gate_exps /
ffn_down_exps and no fused gate_up tensor (Step-3.7-Flash,
DeepSeek-V4-Flash) produce three expert tensors per layer; the
collector array was sized for the fused two-tensor layout, so the
third pointer overflowed the stack during pool registration and
crashed the process before any graph ran.

The collector is now an unbounded std::vector: expert-tensor layouts
vary by arch and future ones may carry any number of expert tensors
per layer, so a fixed-size array is the wrong shape here regardless
of its capacity.

Reported on RTX 5090 / CUDA 13 with Step-3.7-Flash MXFP4 (JigSawPT,
-ncmoe 42 + --moe-expert-cache: registers blk.3 ffn_up_exps and
ffn_gate_exps, segfaults on ffn_down_exps) and independently hit and
fixed on DeepSeek-V4-Flash (TmDagger, fix-moe-pool-rail fork). Our own
test models (fused gate_up + down, two tensors) never exercised the
third slot, which is why the matrix suite passed everywhere.
